title: Zinc carbonic anhydrase mechanism
basic_overview: Zn²⁺ activates water to form a metal-bound hydroxide that attacks CO₂, producing bicarbonate.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Zn–OH attacks CO₂; bicarbonate leaves; water resets site.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Zn–OH₂. 2. Proton transfer → Zn–OH. 3. OH attacks CO₂. 4. Zn–HCO₃ forms. 5. HCO₃⁻ leaves. 6. H₂O binds.
extra_info_content.factors: Zn²⁺ is redox-inert enough for Lewis-acid catalysis and has suitable coordination chemistry.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
